senses.gloss: अचिकित्स्य impossible to amend, not to be discussed. cf. एवं च 'पूजितो य: सुरैरपि' इति अचिकित्स्यः अपशब्दः;Pada- mañjari on P.II.2.12.

आचितादि a class of words headed by the word अाचित which do not have their final vowel accented acute by P. VI.2.146 when they are preceded by the prepositions प्र, परा etc. although they are used as proper nouns. e.g. आचितम्,निरुक्तम्, प्रश्लिष्टम्; cf. Kāśikā on P. VI.2.146.
